text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"On the way back after finishing an errand.
When I invited Cheval Grand to a cafe—"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
I-If you're okay with it, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
......U-Um.
......That's...... not what I meant......

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...I-I want to, too...!
I-I want to go, please...

text_block_list.name: Party Guy
text_block_list.text:
Heeey!
Today's the monthly super-hyped EDM festival!
Everyone, make some nooowise!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Oom-pah, oom-pah♪)
choice_data_list: I-It sure is lively around here...
I-It's pretty lively around here, huh...

text_block_list.name: Party Guy
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Umamusume over thereee!
Let's bounce to the beat even more!!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
…………U-Um!
In that case, well...――

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I-I-I-If you'd like... c-can you come...
...th-there's somewhere I want you to come with me!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Trainer!
The line is taut! You've got a bite!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
P-Please calm down! First, lift the rod
until it bends... Ah, there's no need
to rush reeling it in...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Slowly, watch for the right moment...
When the fish stops trying to escape――now!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...A-Amazing! Trainer,
that's incredible! Even though they weren't biting today!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah... S-Sorry, I got excited all on my own...
I'll go get the net!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cheval Grand and I continue fishing in silence.
Before long, she quietly murmurs something.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, this spot...
is my favorite place."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...Since I'm like this, I get depressed so easily,
and there are so many times where I just end up hating myself..."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"At times like that, I come here... to a world with just me
and the sea, where nobody else is around, and I just
fish for a little while without thinking about anything."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...This place isn't just cozy,
it feels like it accepts someone like me.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
“......Ahaha.
S-Sorry for rambling out of nowhere....”
choice_data_list: You showed me a place that's precious to you, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
......Um, that is... well...
I-I'm... Trai...... ngh......

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: "...When I'm with you, Trainer... I feel like, maybe, I can smile a little better..."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
T-Thank you very much for today.
Um, well...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...I-I'm glad
we could go out together...
choice_data_list: Looks like I won our fishing contest!
Looks like I won our fishing contest!
I want to go horse mackerel fishing again.
To think you knew so much about fishing...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...I-I'm glad
we could go out together...
choice_data_list: Looks like I won our fishing contest!
Looks like I won our fishing contest!
I want to go horse mackerel fishing again.
To think you knew so much about fishing...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it was incredible...!
I think you have every right to be proud of that catch!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe you actually have a hidden talent
for fishing, Trainer...?"
choice_data_list: Alright! Let's catch a whole bunch more!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
Even I won't lose next time, you know?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...If you had fun fishing,
t-then I'm glad...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Horse mackerel requires very little gear compared to other lure fishing,
so I really recommend it.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Next time you go alone, please let me know.
I can lend you the tools whenever you need them.
choice_data_list: Huh, you're not coming with me?
Huh, you're not coming with me?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Huh...
Are you sure it's okay for me to come along...?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
......N-Next time, should we
try mackerel fishing too...?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
N-No, not at all...!
I'm not that knowledgeable about it...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I'm just a little interested in it...
Compared to people who really know their stuff, I'm nothing special...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... R-really, it's
nothing special at all...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"......P-Please don't...
look at me with those eyes......"
